transcript.text: Hi everyone! As I'm preparing the next update to the family genealogy website, I wanted to check in with all of you before we get together at the family gathering. I'd like to go over any corrections, preferences, or practical details you might have — names, dates, photos, stories, anything you want reviewed or changed. Some of our records are based on family recollections rather than original documents, so if anyone has sources or corrections, now is the perfect time to share them. What does everyone think?
